propositions: Define and consolidate a single documentation ownership policy covering eight documentation roles: tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence.

Restore writing guidance (connector, colon, hyphen, paragraph, diction, filler, authenticity-padding, formal-voice rules) as non-deterministic authoring guidance with explicit statement that it does not define a validator or gate contract.

Relocate contributor inventory tables from docs/README.md to docs/generated-artifacts.md and repoint all consumers (tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py) while preserving GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED enforcement sources.
Add concise policy pointers to AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md describing the documentation ownership, correction, and writing-guidance policy without adding enforcement gates.

Preserve pre-F01 descriptions for generated-artifact catalog rows (docs/cli-reference.md, server.json, criteria_routing.json, reviewer-prompt) and all catalog entries, regeneration commands, and enforcement gates.
Exclude all deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validators; new hooks, test gates, CI gates, or runtime rejection; and repository-wide prose rewrite.
